{{Short description|Indian journalist}} {{Use dmy dates|date=October 2025}} {{Use Indian English|date=October 2025}} {{Infobox person | name = Ajit Anjum | image = Ajit_Anjum.jpg | caption = | birth_date = {{Birth date and age|1969|04|07|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Begusarai]], [[Bihar]], [[India]] | alma_mater = [[Bihar University]], [[Muzaffarpur]] | occupation = Journalist | years_active = 1989–present | spouse = Geeta Shree | parents = | relatives = | awards = [[Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Awards]] in 2010 | website = }} '''Ajit Anjum''' is an Indian journalist. He has worked as [[managing editor]] at [[News 24 (India)|News 24]] and [[India TV]] news channels.{{cite web|url=https://www.indiantelevision.com/television/tv-channels/people/ajit-anjum-set-to-join-india-tv-as-managing-editor-140714|title=Ajit Anjum set to join India TV as managing editor|date= 14 July 2014|publisher=Indian Television}}
- {{cite web|url=https://www.indiatvnews.com/news/india/india-tv-appoint-ajit-anjum-managing-editor-40464.html|title=India TV appoints Ajit Anjum as Managing Editor|date= 13 August 2014|website=India TV News}}
- {{cite web|url=https://www.exchange4media.com/people-movement-news/india-tv-appoints-ajit-anjum-as-managing-editor-56993.html|website=Exchange4media|title=India TV appoints Ajit Anjum as Managing Editor |date=14 August 2014 |accessdate=8 July 2019}}
- {{Cite web| url=https://www.bhadas4media.com/ajit-anjum-news24-india-tv/|publisher=Bhadas4 Media| title=न्यूज24 से अजीत अंजुम का इस्तीफ़ा, इंडिया टीवी ज्वाइन करेंगे|date=11 July 2014 |accessdate=8 July 2016 }} He was awarded the [[Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Awards]] in 2010.{{cite web|url=https://scroll.in/video/919433/watch-union-minister-ravi-shankar-prasad-left-a-live-tv-show-because-he-didnt-like-the-questions|website=Scroll|title=Union minister Ravi Shankar Prasad left a live TV show because he didn't like the questions|date=10 April 2019 |accessdate=8 July 2019}}
- {{cite web | url=https://www.exchange4media.com/media-tv-news/why-did-ajit-anjum-leave-tv9-bharatvarsh-99424.html|title=Why did Ajit Anjum leave TV9 Bharatvarsh?|website=Exchange4media|date=10 September 2019 |accessdate=9 October 2019}} He is known as a [[center-left]] journalist who is known for critical reporting of [[Bharatiya Janata Party|BJP]]. ==Early life== Anjum, named Ajit Kumar at birth, was born in the [[Begusarai]] district of [[Bihar]]. His father, Ramsagar Prasad Singh, was in the Bihar Judicial Services as a judge at [[Patna]].{{Cite web| url=http://bolozindagi.com/%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%88-%E0%A4%AC%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0-%E0%A4%9C%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%97%E0%A5%80-%E0%A4%95%E0%A5%8B-%E0%A4%AC%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%A8%E0%A4%BE-%E0%A4%AA%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%B2%E0%A4%BE/|website=Bolozindagi | title=कई बार ज़िंदगी को बिना प्लान किये छोड़ देना चाहिए |accessdate=8 July 2016 }} Anjum had his early education at [[Begusarai]] and [[Darbhanga]]. He obtained his bachelor's degree from [[Langat Singh College]], [[Muzaffarpur]], affiliated to [[Bihar University]]. Anjum started his career as a journalist while pursuing his studies at Muzaffarpur. He changed his last name from Kumar to Anjum while working as a local reporter at the ''Patliputra Times.'' Working as freelance journalist in Patna, he wrote for ''[[Dharmyug]]'', ''Saptahik Hindustaan'', ''Dinmaan'' and ''[[Ravivar]]''. He went to Delhi in 1989 and started working at ''[[Amar Ujala]]''.{{Cite web| url=http://mediakhabar.com/ajit-anjum-guru-purnima/|website=Media Khabar| title=दिल्ली में रिपोर्टिंग का ज़िम्मा मिला और लगा कि ज़िंदगी का एक सपना साकार हो गया |date=22 July 2013 |accessdate=8 July 2016 }} ==Career== In 1994, Anjum began his career in journalism by joining BAG Films as director of the talk show ''Rubaru'' hosted by the Congress leader [[Rajeev Shukla]]. He worked for fifteen years with BAG Films and produced many shows in that period. He then moved to [[Aaj Tak]] as a senior producer but did not stay there very long. He rejoined BAG Films and, as an employee of BAF, he spearheaded the launch of [[News 24 (India)|News 24]] in 2007. While with News 24, he was awarded the Ramnath Goenka Award for his reporting of the flood in Bihar in 2010. Anjum managed a campaign on News 24 that resulted in truckloads of relief materials reaching the victims. As a result, ''Fem'' magazine mentioned him in its list of 50 most powerful people of Bihar in its survey conducted in 2016.{{Cite web |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P0fwhshFTI4 |website=YouTube |title=Ajit Anjum reporting with social responsibility during Bihar |date=11 August 2010 |accessdate=8 July 2016 }}

- {{cite web|url=https://www.indiantelevision.com/television/tv-channels/news-broadcasting/tv9-bharatvarsh-launched-to-focus-on-investigative-journalism-190401?amp|title=TV9 Bharatvarsh launched; to focus on investigative journalism|date=1 April 2019|publisher=Indian Television}} He left News 24 in 2014 and joined [[India TV]] as its managing editor, working under editor-in-chief [[Rajat Sharma]].{{cite web|url=https://www.indiatvnews.com/video/india-tv-exclusive-ajit-anjum-interviews-bjp-president-amit-shah-on-delhi-assembly-election-66426.131.html|title=Ajit Anjum interviews BJP president Amit Shah on Delhi Assembly Election|date= 21 January 2015|website=India TV News}} While Anjum was working at India TV, a senior correspondent of the same TV news channel, Imran Shaikh, accused Anjum of pressurising him to tweak news in favour of a political party.{{Cite web |last=Dasgupta |first=Subhabrata |title=Former India TV Journalist accuses channel of forcing him to "fabricate" news |url=https://www.newslaundry.com/2016/10/13/former-india-tv-journalist-accuses-channel-of-forcing-him-to-fabricate-news |access-date=5 November 2022 |website=Newslaundry |date=13 October 2016 }} Anjum denied the charge through a Facebook post. While working with [[ABP News|Star News]] (Now [[ABP News]]), he conceptualised shows like ''Red Alert,'' ''Sansani'' and ''Bamboo mein Tamboo.''{{cite web|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/after-the-sting-the-pain-107091001007_1.html|work=Business Standard|title=After the sting, the pain|accessdate=8 July 2019}} ==Controversy== In 2013, 08 journalists, Ajit Anjum, Anchor Suhail, and reporter Sunil Dutt, who worked with News24 and editor-in-chief [[Deepak Chaurasia]]; anchors Tripathi and Rashid Hashmi; Jodhpur reporter Lalit Singh Badgurjar; and producer Abhinav Raj, who worked for India News, were charged with preparation of forged video of a minor girl, who was victim of sexual assault, and her family by showing them in an indecent manner and telecasting it on news channels. {{cite web|title=2013 POCSO case: Court frames charges against Deepak Chaurasia, 7 other media professionals| url=https://www.newslaundry.com/2023/08/29/2013-pocso-case-court-frames-charges-against-deepak-chaurasia-7-other-media-professionals|work=News Laundry |access-date=8 June 2026}} {{cite web|title=2013 पॉक्सो केस: दीपक चौरसिया, चित्रा त्रिपाठी, अजीत अंजुम समेत 8 लोगों पर आरोप तय| url=https://hindi.newslaundry.com/2023/08/29/gurugram-court-frame-charges-against-8-including-deepak-chaurasiya-chitra-tripathi-and-ajit-anjum|work=News Laundry |access-date=8 June 2026}} They have accordingly been charged under sections 120B, 469, 471 IPC, sections 67B and 67 IT Act and sections 23 of POCSO Act.{{cite web|title=Asaram Bapu sexual assault: Gurugram court rejects anticipatory bail to journalist Chitra Tripathi | url=https://www.theweek.in/news/india/2024/11/29/asaram-bapu-sexual-assault-gurugram-court-rejects-anticipatory-bail-to-journalist-chitra-tripathi-in-pocso-case.html|work=The Week |access-date=8 June 2026}} {{cite web|title=Gurgaon court denies anticipatory bail to news anchor Chitra Tripathi| url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/delhi/gurgaon-court-denies-anticipatory-bail-news-anchor-chitra-tripathi-9696586/|work=Indian Express |access-date=8 June 2026}} The matter is presently being heard before Special POCSO Court in Gurugram, Haryana, where Charges have been framed against the accused. {{cite web|title=POCSO Case: Gurugram Court Frames Charges Against Deepak Chaurasiya, Chitra Tripathi, 6 Other Journalists; Trial To Begin On Sep 25| url=https://www.livelaw.in/news-updates/pocso-case-gurugram-court-frames-charges-deepak-chaurasiya-chitra-tripathi-journalists-trial-september-25-236508|work=Live Law |access-date=8 June 2026}} {{cite web|title=2013 High Court Grants Relief To Journalist Chitra Tripathi, Sets Aside Gurugram Court's Arrest Warrants| url=https://www.livelaw.in/high-court/punjab-and-haryana-high-court/punjab-and-haryana-high-court-pocso-case-grants-relief-journalist-chitra-tripathi-sets-aside-gurugram-court-arrest-warrants-277790|work=Live Law|access-date=8 June 2026}} ==Awards== * [[Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Awards]], 2010.{{cite web|url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/delhi/31-journalists-get-ramnath-goenka-awards/story-KegbNy2y83Ktg1vp6j3AeP.html|title=31 journalists get Ramnath Goenka Awards|date= 23 July 2010|work=Hindustan Times}}

extract: Ajit Anjum is an Indian journalist. He has worked as managing editor at News 24 and India TV news channels. He was awarded the Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Awards in 2010. He is known as a center-left journalist who is known for critical reporting of BJP.
